verses.1: A song of ascents. Happy are all who fear the LORD, who walk in the ways of God.
verses.2: What your hands provide you will enjoy; you will be happy and prosper:
verses.3: Like a fruitful vine your wife within your home, Like olive plants your children around your table.
verses.4: Just so will they be blessed who fear the LORD.
verses.5: May the LORD bless you from Zion, all the days of your life That you may share Jerusalem's joy
verses.6: and live to see your children's children. Peace upon Israel!

notes.text: All who fear the LORD: literally, singular: "the one fearing," is used in a typical sense and so is translated by the plural
